description: Ordered conservative mapping rules for actual NHTSA COMPDESC values observed in COMPLAINTS_RECEIVED_2020-2024.txt. Unmatched components remain unmapped.

values: ENGINE AND ENGINE COOLING:EXHAUST SYSTEM:EMISSION CONTROL
rules.reason: Emissions-only subcomponents are outside the initial roadside model.
These subcomponents explicitly identify the engine cooling system.
These power-train subcomponents explicitly identify a transmission or clutch assembly.
NHTSA brake, hydraulic, air, electric, ABS, and parking-brake components map directly to the project brake class.
The NHTSA component explicitly identifies the vehicle electrical system.
Broad ENGINE and legacy ENGINE AND ENGINE COOLING components are retained as engine faults unless a preceding cooling or emissions rule applies.
These components identify fuel storage, delivery, injection, or propulsion-system complaints.
Tyre and wheel components map directly to the project wheel/tyre class.
The NHTSA component explicitly identifies the steering system.
Non-transmission power-train components map to the project drivetrain class.
